errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reports the values for the red line in 2016 and 2020. The value for 2016 is slightly below 23.0% (approximately 22.8%), not exactly 23.0%. The value for 2020 is 23.0%, not 25.0%; the description incorrectly uses the maximum value of the right y-axis instead of the actual data point.
The description estimates the value for the red line in 2018 as "около 22,5%" (around 22.5%), but visually, the data point is closer to 22.0%.
